mission: TAR-FRL-VEC Master Engineering and Research Verification Gates
verdict_rationale: 7 of 8 gates fully PASS with 100% reproducible evidence and zero test failures. Gate 7 passes headless AppTest and asset self-containment checks, but visual browser interaction is explicitly marked NOT VERIFIED due to the absence of browser automation tooling in the execution environment.

gate_1.name: Phase 10 Historical Benchmark Integrity
gate_1.evidence: MANIFEST CHECK PASSED: 894 artifacts re-hashed, row counts stable. Zero bytes modified in historical benchmark directory.

gate_2.name: Policy-Context and Offloading Correctness
gate_2.evidence: Strict policy mode implemented and verified (ValueError on invalid action, RuntimeError on policy error). Context injection ctx={'candidates': cands, 'env': env} resolves 0% offload bug. Diagnostic telemetry captures invalid actions and policy exceptions.

gate_3.name: SUMO Microscopic Mobility and Handover Accounting
gate_3.evidence: Deterministic spatial handover mechanics verified in test_deterministic_spatial_handover_mechanics: association at X=300m, handover at X=620m (RSU 0 -> RSU 1), disconnection at X=1100m. HandoverEvent expanded with dist_to_prev_rsu_m, dist_to_new_rsu_m, and reason. Vehicle network departure tracked.

gate_4.name: Mathematical Model and Threat-Model Consistency with Executable Code
gate_4.evidence: 17-row specification-to-implementation matrix documented with exact SI units. Shannon link rate, CMOS dynamic energy scaling, 22-dimensional MDP state layout, reward coefficients (w_l=1.0, w_e=0.3, w_s=2.0, c_fail=3.0, c_dl=2.0, w_t=0.5), Beta trust decay (lambda=0.95), and robust aggregation threshold (tau=0.30/0.40) fully reconciled.

gate_5.name: Peer-Reviewed Literature and Research-Gap Verification
gate_5.command: python -c "import csv; rows = list(csv.DictReader(open('docs/RESEARCH_GAP_MATRIX.csv', encoding='utf-8'))); assert len(rows) == 8; print('All verified:', all(r['verified_status'] == 'VERIFIED' for r in rows))"
gate_5.evidence: 8 peer-reviewed publications verified with exact DOIs / stable publisher URLs (AISTATS 2017, NeurIPS 2017, ICML 2018, IEEE IoT-J 2022, IEEE TVT 2022, AISTATS 2020, IEEE COMST 2020, IEEE WCM 2019). Research gap narrowed to composite behavioral + model-update trust for VEC under microscopic mobility.

gate_6.name: Multi-Seed SUMO Experiment Reproducibility and Statistical Validity
gate_6.evidence: Reproduced 15 experimental runs across 5 policies and 3 random seeds (42, 101, 2024). Bit-for-bit exact match against committed results in results/sumo_experiments/. 95% Student-t confidence intervals, paired Cohen's d effect sizes (d=3.58), CMOS energy anomaly diagnosis, and FedDQN domain-gap analysis fully documented in reports/verification/EXPERIMENT_REPRODUCTION.md.

gate_7.name: Dashboard and Browser-Visible Simulation Verification
gate_7.evidence: Streamlit AppTest.from_file('dashboard/app.py') executed headlessly with 0 exceptions. Three.js and OrbitControls libraries verified present locally in dashboard/static/ (100% offline self-contained, no external CDN dependencies). Actual visual browser rendering marked NOT VERIFIED per strict instructions because browser automation tooling is not equipped in the environment.

gate_8.name: Full Regression Suite and Final Acceptance
gate_8.evidence: 183/183 tests passed across all 17 test modules. Manifest re-check confirmed 894 artifacts intact.

defect_register.defect: Identical policy metrics in SUMO smoke experiment due to missing context injection
defect_register.root_cause: dashboard/simulator_engine.py invoked policy(obs, mask) without ctx={'candidates': cands, 'env': env}, causing heuristic baselines to find empty candidates and default to local action (0).
defect_register.code_fix: Injected ctx in dashboard/simulator_engine.py with adaptive dispatch and added strict_policy parameter.
defect_register.verification_result: PASS (8/8 tests passed; baselines produce distinct offload fractions in SUMO experiments)

defect_register.defect: Handover accounting conflation & insufficient spatial corridor horizon in smoke runs
defect_register.root_cause: scripts/run_sumo_smoke_experiment.py labeled all association events as handovers; 20-task smoke duration was too short for vehicles to reach handover overlap zone (X in [500m, 700m]).
defect_register.code_fix: Disaggregated associations, handovers, disconnections, and network departures in HandoverEvent and environment/sumo_env.py.
defect_register.verification_result: PASS (9/9 tests passed; deterministic transitions verified at X=300m, X=620m, X=1100m)

defect_register.defect: TraCI process lifecycle socket leaks on interrupted runs
defect_register.root_cause: Orphaned SUMO processes could persist if TraCI connections aborted without explicit process termination.
defect_register.code_fix: Added robust process termination (popen.terminate/kill) and explicit exception guards in SumoVehicularEdgeEnv.close().
defect_register.verification_result: PASS (15 multi-seed SUMO experiment runs completed cleanly without socket exhaustion)

defect_register.defect: Apparent CMOS energy scaling anomaly between RSU and vehicular offloading
defect_register.root_cause: Total task energy accounting calculates E = P_tx * T_tx + kappa * C * f^2. Edge RSUs operate at 10 GHz vs vehicle 2 GHz, incurring 25x higher dynamic power density per clock cycle.
defect_register.code_fix: Formally audited and documented in docs/MATHEMATICAL_MODEL.md Section 3 and reports/verification/EXPERIMENT_REPRODUCTION.md.
defect_register.verification_result: PASS (Mathematical consistency verified; energy values confirmed physically consistent with CMOS scaling)

defect_register.defect: Byzantine robust aggregation division-by-zero risk when all clients fall below threshold
defect_register.root_cause: If S_r is empty (all clients malicious), standard normalization divides by zero.
defect_register.code_fix: Verified safe fallback w^{r+1} = w^r preserving last known benign model parameters without numerical failure.

defect_register.defect: Synthetic fallback in SumoVehicularEdgeEnv failed when vehicle_cpu_ghz is None
defect_register.root_cause: Direct float conversion float(self.cfg.vehicle_cpu_ghz * 1e9) raised TypeError when vehicle_cpu_ghz is None.
defect_register.code_fix: Added safe None check with fallback to uniform(1.2, 2.8) GHz in environment/sumo_env.py lines 171 & 185.
defect_register.verification_result: PASS (Synthetic fallback runs smoothly without configuration errors)
